connector.name: MCP by getcoherence.io
connector.registryDescription: Coherence MCP - chat with your CRM's AI agent from Claude, Cursor, and Cline.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.getcoherence, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: COHERENCE_API_TOKEN
env.description: API key from your Coherence workspace (Settings → API Keys). Starts with sk_live_.

env.name: COHERENCE_API_URL
env.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.getcoherence.io/v1.
